headline.label: sold records that don't belong in the math

text: Two cards, 39 sold records since May. Seven of them would bend a plain average: a $46 "PSA 9 Crystal Charizard," a $1,900 "PSA 8 Crystal Lugia," a raw card and a two-grade slab in a PSA 8 search, a double-counted auction, and one listing that sold twice.

items.label: DATA_ERROR
items.why: $46 for a PSA 9 Crystal Charizard. Whatever sold, it wasn't this card.

items.label: BEST_OFFER
items.why: Listed at $39,999, sold for $35,800. Trackers that show the ask get this one wrong.

items.label: RELIST
items.why: The same listing sold on Sep 6 for $17,750, then again on Sep 15. Both count half.

items.label: DUPLICATE
items.why: Same title, same price, same 31 bids, a day apart. Counted once.

items.label: DATA_ERROR
items.why: Two grades in one title (CGC 8.5 and PSA 8).

labels.name: Clean
labels.meaning: A real sale of the right card. Counts in full.

labels.name: Relist
labels.meaning: The same listing sold more than once. The first sale may not have gone through. Counts half.

labels.name: Best offer
labels.meaning: Shown at the accepted price, not the asking price.

labels.name: Duplicate
labels.meaning: One sale recorded twice. Counted once.

labels.name: Doesn't belong
labels.meaning: Wrong card, wrong grade, or a price no real copy sells for. Left out.
